mapper.sql: (SELECT lpad(trunc(std_val)::text,6,'0') FROM tb_sy_oper_std WHERE std_cd='CASH_BASE_YM' ORDER BY aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1)
mapper.select: SELECT pl_ym AS "month",sales_amt AS "salesAmt",alloc_cost_amt AS "allocCostAmt",idle_cost_amt AS "idleCostAmt", drct_exps_amt AS "drctExpsAmt",sales_cost_amt AS "salesCostAmt",gross_prft_amt AS "grossPrftAmt",sga_input_amt AS "sgaInputAmt", indrct_labor_amt AS "indrctLaborAmt",rnd_amt AS "rndAmt",sga_tot_amt AS "sgaTotAmt",prev_adj_amt AS "prevAdjAmt", oprt_prft_amt AS "oprtPrftAmt",nopr_incm_amt AS "noprIncmAmt",nopr_exps_amt AS "noprExpsAmt",corp_tax_amt AS "corpTaxAmt", net_prft_amt AS "netPrftAmt",migr_yn AS "migrated",fix_yn AS "fixed",reg_user_id AS "regUserId",reg_dttm AS "regDttm",mod_user_id AS "modUserId",mod_dttm AS "modDttm" FROM tb_co_mon_pl WHERE ORDER BY pl_ym

SELECT jsonb_build_object('profits',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p) ORDER BY p.pl_ym),'[]'::jsonb) FROM tb_co_mon_pl p WHERE ), 'base',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(b) ORDER BY b.aply_bgn_ym),'[]'::jsonb) FROM tb_sy_oper_std b WHERE std_cd='CASH_BASE_YM'))::text
mapper.sql: upld_id::bigint AS "uploadId",form_type_cd AS "formType",scrn_id AS "screenId",file_nm AS "filename",file_size::bigint AS "size",trgt_ym AS "month",trgt_proj_id AS "projectId",trgt_dstrb_step_cd AS "step",reg_user_id AS "actor",upld_stat_cd AS "status",tot_row_cnt::int AS "totalRows",succ_cnt::int AS "successRows",warn_cnt::int AS "warningRows",err_cnt::int AS "errorRows",aply_dttm AS "appliedAt"
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tb_sy_upld WHERE upld_id=#{uploadId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_sy_upld SET tot_row_cnt=#{summary.totalRows},succ_cnt=#{summary.successRows},warn_cnt=#{summary.warningRows},err_cnt=#{summary.errorRows},upld_stat_cd='CHECKED',mod_user_id=#{actor},mod_dttm=#{now} WHERE upld_id=#{uploadId} AND upld_stat_cd='CHECKED'
mapper.select: SELECT rslt_sn::int AS "sequence",rslt_type_cd AS "severity",row_no::int AS "rowNumber",coalesce(col_nm,'') AS "columnName",coalesce(input_val,'') AS "inputValue",rsn_cn AS "reason" FROM tb_sy_upld_err WHERE upld_id=#{uploadId} ORDER BY rslt_sn

SELECT DISTINCT substring(trgt_key,1,4)||'-'||substring(trgt_key,5,2) FROM tb_sy_chg_hist WHERE trgt_tbl_nm='TB_CO_MON_PL' AND chg_type_cd IN ('NEW','UPD') AND split_part(chg_rsn,':',1)='HistoricalProfitLossImport' AND split_part(chg_rsn,':',2)=CAST(#{uploadId} AS text) ORDER BY 1
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_co_mon_pl SET sales_amt=#{amounts.salesAmt},sales_cost_amt=#{amounts.salesCostAmt},sga_tot_amt=#{amounts.sgaTotAmt},oprt_prft_amt=#{amounts.oprtPrftAmt},alloc_cost_amt=#{amounts.allocCostAmt},idle_cost_amt=#{amounts.idleCostAmt},drct_exps_amt=#{amounts.drctExpsAmt},gross_prft_amt=#{amounts.grossPrftAmt},sga_input_amt=#{amounts.sgaInputAmt},indrct_labor_amt=#{amounts.indrctLaborAmt},rnd_amt=#{amounts.rndAmt},prev_adj_amt=#{amounts.prevAdjAmt},nopr_incm_amt=#{amounts.noprIncmAmt},nopr_exps_amt=#{amounts.noprExpsAmt},corp_tax_amt=#{amounts.corpTaxAmt},net_prft_amt=#{amounts.netPrftAmt},migr_yn='Y',fix_yn='Y',mod_user_id=#{actor},mod_dttm=#{now} WHERE pl_ym=#{month} AND pl_ym < #{base} AND pl_ym >= ((substring(#{base},1,4)::int-1)::text||'01')
UPDATE tb_sy_upld SET upld_stat_cd='APPLIED',aply_dttm=#{now},mod_user_id=#{actor},mod_dttm=#{now} WHERE upld_id=#{uploadId} AND upld_stat_cd='CHECKED'
